assay: total RNA-seq (RiboZero), vastus lateralis, HiSeq 2500; STAR + featureCounts-style gene counts (S4.4.p1, S4.5.p1)
primary_estimand: Within-subject effect of one acute 30-min cycling bout (85% HRmax) on skeletal muscle gene expression, immediately post and after 3 h recovery vs rest, separately in men with NGT and men with T2D (S2.2.p1, FIG2)
sample_inclusion: 20 T2D + 17 NGT analyzed (FIG2 legend); 2 samples excluded for poor correlation/PCA, 1 donor excluded with only baseline left (S4.5.p1). Identity of excluded samples not stated.
planned_contrasts: T2D recovery vs basal (FIG2B; 3185 genes unique to this group)
exercise x T2D interaction at recovery (FIG2F-G, GSEA only)
normalization: edgeR (TMM implied); filter: >= 10*n counts in at least one of six diagnosis x time groups (S4.5.p1)
paper_results: Only one DEG number given: 3185 genes unique to T2D recovery in the Venn intersection (S2.2.p2); totals per contrast are in Fig. 2B but not in text. Cytokines CCL2, CXCL2, CXCL12 etc. exercise-responsive (S2.4.p1).
